text: I don't give trade instructions or size positions; that decision stays with you, and any size suggestion would only come from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. What the pack can say: the release-day WTI move explains the surprise rather than predicting it (-0.3481% per 1 sd since 2001, -0.223% since 2015), and the next WPSR is on 2026-10-28. If you want to frame an idea, journal it and run the critic card and the sizing assistant.
